const DANGEROUS_KEYS = new Set(["__proto__", "constructor", "prototype"]);
const MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS = 4096;

const record = (value: unknown): Record<string, any> | null => {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const candidate = value as Record<string, any>;
  return Object.keys(candidate).some((key) => DANGEROUS_KEYS.has(key)) ? null : candidate;
};
const stableJson = (value: unknown): string => {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(stableJson).join(",")}]`;
  const candidate = record(value);
  if (candidate !== null) return `{${Object.keys(candidate).sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${stableJson(candidate[key])}`).join(",")}}`;
  return JSON.stringify(value);
};
const ownedFrozen = (value: unknown): any => {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (value.length > MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS) throw new Error("workflow profile collection exceeds bound");
    return Object.freeze(value.map(ownedFrozen));
  }
  const candidate = record(value);
  if (candidate !== null) {
    const keys = Object.keys(candidate);
    if (keys.length > MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS) throw new Error("workflow profile object exceeds bound");
    return Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key) => [key, ownedFrozen(candidate[key])])));
  }
  return value;
};
const schemaRecord = (value: unknown): Record<string, any> => {
  const candidate = record(value);
  if (candidate === null) throw new Error("generated workflow profile schema is malformed");
  return candidate;
};
const resolveReference = (reference: unknown): Record<string, any> => {
  const prefix = "#/$defs/";
  if (typeof reference !== "string" || !reference.startsWith(prefix)) throw new Error("unsupported workflow profile schema reference");
  return schemaRecord(schemaRecord(SCHEMA.$defs)[reference.slice(prefix.length)]);
};
const typeMatches = (value: unknown, kind: unknown): boolean => {
  if (kind === "null") return value === null;
  if (kind === "boolean") return typeof value === "boolean";
  if (kind === "integer") return typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value);
  if (kind === "number") return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value);
  if (kind === "string") return typeof value === "string";
  if (kind === "array") return Array.isArray(value);
  if (kind === "object") return record(value) !== null;
  return false;
};
const validationErrors = (value: unknown, node: Record<string, any>, path: string): string[] => {
  if (node.$ref !== undefined) return validationErrors(value, resolveReference(node.$ref), path);
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (node.const !== undefined && stableJson(value) !== stableJson(node.const)) errors.push(`${path}: const`);
  if (Array.isArray(node.enum) && !node.enum.some((item: unknown) => stableJson(value) === stableJson(item))) errors.push(`${path}: enum`);
  if (Array.isArray(node.oneOf)) {
    const matches = node.oneOf.filter((item: unknown) => validationErrors(value, schemaRecord(item), path).length === 0).length;
    if (matches !== 1) errors.push(`${path}: alternatives`);
  }
  const types = Array.isArray(node.type) ? node.type : node.type === undefined ? [] : [node.type];
  if (types.length > 0 && !types.some((kind: unknown) => typeMatches(value, kind))) errors.push(`${path}: type`);
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    if (typeof node.minimum === "number" && value < node.minimum) errors.push(`${path}: minimum`);
    if (typeof node.maximum === "number" && value > node.maximum) errors.push(`${path}: maximum`);
  }
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    if (typeof node.minLength === "number" && value.length < node.minLength) errors.push(`${path}: minLength`);
    if (typeof node.maxLength === "number" && value.length > node.maxLength) errors.push(`${path}: maxLength`);
    if (typeof node.pattern === "string" && !new RegExp(node.pattern, "u").test(value)) errors.push(`${path}: pattern`);
    if (node.format === "date-time" && Number.isNaN(Date.parse(value))) errors.push(`${path}: format`);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (typeof node.minItems === "number" && value.length < node.minItems) errors.push(`${path}: minItems`);
    if (typeof node.maxItems === "number" && value.length > node.maxItems) return [...errors, `${path}: maxItems`];
    if (node.uniqueItems === true && new Set(value.map(stableJson)).size !== value.length) errors.push(`${path}: uniqueItems`);
    if (record(node.items) !== null) value.forEach((item, index) => errors.push(...validationErrors(item, schemaRecord(node.items), `${path}/${index}`)));
  }
  const candidate = record(value);
  if (candidate !== null && (types.includes("object") || record(node.properties) !== null)) {
    const required = Array.isArray(node.required) ? node.required : [];
    for (const key of required) if (typeof key === "string" && !(key in candidate)) errors.push(`${path}/${key}: required`);
    const properties = record(node.properties) ?? {};
    if (node.additionalProperties === false) for (const key of Object.keys(candidate)) if (!(key in properties)) errors.push(`${path}/${key}: additional property`);
    for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(properties)) if (key in candidate) errors.push(...validationErrors(candidate[key], schemaRecord(child), `${path}/${key}`));
  }
  return errors;
};
const definition = (name: string): Record<string, any> => schemaRecord(schemaRecord(SCHEMA.$defs)[name]);
const distinct = (values: unknown[]): boolean => new Set(values.map(stableJson)).size === values.length;
const profileMap = (catalog: Record<string, any>): Map<string, Record<string, any>> => new Map(catalog.profiles.map((profile: Record<string, any>) => [profile.profileId, profile]));
const expectedProfileReference = (catalog: Record<string, any>, profile: Record<string, any>): Record<string, any> => ({
  referenceId: catalog.governedReference.referenceId,
  referenceVersion: catalog.governedReference.referenceVersion,
  workflowCatalogHash: catalog.governedReference.workflowCatalogHash,
  pageContractsHash: catalog.governedReference.pageContractsHash,
  profileCatalogVersion: catalog.profileCatalogVersion,
  profileCatalogHash: APPROVED_WORKFLOW_PROFILE_CATALOG_SHA256,
  profileId: profile.profileId,
  profileVersion: profile.profileVersion,
  profileRevision: profile.profileRevision,
  sourceWorkflowHash: profile.sourceWorkflowHash,
});
const exactProfile = (catalog: Record<string, any>, value: unknown): Record<string, any> | null => {
  const reference = record(value);
  if (reference === null) return null;
  const profile = profileMap(catalog).get(reference.profileId);
  return profile !== undefined && stableJson(reference) === stableJson(expectedProfileReference(catalog, profile)) ? profile : null;
};
const unique = (values: unknown[]): boolean => new Set(values).size === values.length;
const immediateIntentRevision = (priorValue: unknown, targetValue: unknown): boolean => {
  const prior = record(priorValue);
  const target = record(targetValue);
  return prior !== null && target !== null
    && prior.intentId === target.intentId
    && target.revision === prior.revision + 1
    && target.revisionId !== prior.revisionId
    && target.revisionContentHash !== prior.revisionContentHash;
};
const semanticStageMapping = (fromProfile: Record<string, any>, toProfile: Record<string, any>, item: Record<string, any>): boolean => {
  const source = (fromProfile.stages as Record<string, any>[]).find((stage) => stage.stageKey === item.fromStageKey);
  const target = item.targetStageKey === null ? undefined : (toProfile.stages as Record<string, any>[]).find((stage) => stage.stageKey === item.targetStageKey);
  if (source === undefined) return false;
  if (item.disposition === "retain") return target !== undefined && target.stageKey === source.stageKey && target.pageContractId === source.pageContractId;
  if (item.disposition === "map") return target !== undefined && target.stageKey !== source.stageKey;
  return target === undefined && item.targetStageKey === null;
};

export function workflowProfileCatalogErrors(value: unknown): readonly string[] {
  try {
    const errors = validationErrors(value, definition("WorkflowProfileCatalog"), "$");
    if (errors.length > 0) return [...new Set(errors)];
    const catalog = record(value)!;
    const profiles = catalog.profiles as Record<string, any>[];
    if (stableJson(catalog) !== stableJson(APPROVED_CATALOG)) errors.push("catalog-binds-governed-reference");
    if (!unique(profiles.map((profile) => profile.profileId))) errors.push("catalog-profile-identities-are-exact");
    for (const profile of profiles) {
      const stages = profile.stages as Record<string, any>[];
      if (!unique(stages.map((stage) => stage.stageKey)) || stages.some((stage, index) => stage.order !== index + 1)) errors.push("profile-stages-are-ordered-and-unique");
      if ((profile.cyclePolicy === "revisitable") !== Boolean((APPROVED_CATALOG.profiles as Record<string, any>[]).find((item) => item.profileId === profile.profileId)?.cyclePolicy === "revisitable")) errors.push("catalog-binds-governed-reference");
    }
    return [...new Set(errors)];
  } catch {
    return ["workflow-profile-catalog-structure-invalid"];
  }
}

export function projectWorkflowSelectionErrors(catalogValue: unknown, value: unknown): readonly string[] {
  if (workflowProfileCatalogErrors(catalogValue).length > 0) return ["workflow-profile-catalog-invalid"];
  try {
    const errors = validationErrors(value, definition("ProjectWorkflowSelection"), "$");
    if (errors.length > 0) return [...new Set(errors)];
    const catalog = record(catalogValue)!;
    const selection = record(value)!;
    if (exactProfile(catalog, selection.profile) === null || selection.projectId === selection.selectionId || selection.selectionId === selection.selectionRevisionId || selection.researchIntent.intentId === selection.researchIntent.revisionId) errors.push("selection-binds-catalog-profile-and-intent");
    const parent = record(selection.parentSelection);
    if ((selection.revision === 1 && parent !== null) || (selection.revision > 1 && (parent === null || parent.revision !== selection.revision - 1 || parent.selectionId !== selection.selectionId || parent.selectionRevisionId === selection.selectionRevisionId || parent.revisionContentHash === selection.revisionContentHash || exactProfile(catalog, parent.profile) === null))) errors.push("selection-lineage-is-immediate");
    const impact = record(selection.impactPreview);
    if ((selection.revision === 1 && impact !== null) || (selection.revision > 1 && (impact === null || parent === null || stableJson(impact.priorSelection) !== stableJson(parent) || stableJson(impact.targetProfile) !== stableJson(selection.profile) || impact.historyPolicy !== "preserve"))) errors.push("profile-change-binds-impact-preview");
    const acceptedMigration = record(selection.acceptedMigration);
    if (selection.revision === 1) {
      if (acceptedMigration !== null) errors.push("profile-change-binds-intent-and-human-acceptance");
    } else if (parent === null || acceptedMigration === null
      || stableJson(parent.profile) === stableJson(selection.profile)
      || stableJson(acceptedMigration.fromProfile) !== stableJson(parent.profile)
      || stableJson(acceptedMigration.toProfile) !== stableJson(selection.profile)
      || stableJson(acceptedMigration.targetResearchIntent) !== stableJson(selection.researchIntent)
      || !immediateIntentRevision(acceptedMigration.priorResearchIntent, acceptedMigration.targetResearchIntent)
      || acceptedMigration.priorResearchIntent.intentId !== parent.researchIntent.intentId
      || acceptedMigration.priorResearchIntent.revision < parent.researchIntent.revision
      || stableJson(acceptedMigration.acceptance.decidedBy) !== stableJson(selection.selectedBy)) {
      errors.push("profile-change-binds-intent-and-human-acceptance");
    }
    if (impact !== null && parent !== null) {
      const priorProfile = exactProfile(catalog, parent.profile);
      const targetProfile = exactProfile(catalog, selection.profile);
      const items = impact.priorStageStates as Record<string, any>[];
      const priorKeys = new Set((priorProfile?.stages ?? []).map((stage: Record<string, any>) => stage.stageKey));
      const targetKeys = new Set((targetProfile?.stages ?? []).map((stage: Record<string, any>) => stage.stageKey));
      if (!unique(items.map((item) => `${item.stageStateId}:${item.stageStateRevisionId}`)) || items.some((item) => item.stageStateId === item.stageStateRevisionId || !priorKeys.has(item.fromStageKey) || (item.targetStageKey !== null && !targetKeys.has(item.targetStageKey)) || (["retain", "map"].includes(item.disposition) && item.targetStageKey === null))) errors.push("impact-preview-preserves-stage-history");
      if (priorProfile !== null && targetProfile !== null && items.some((item) => !semanticStageMapping(priorProfile, targetProfile, item))) errors.push("migration-disposition-is-semantic");
    }
    return [...new Set(errors)];
  } catch {
    return ["project-workflow-selection-structure-invalid"];
  }
}

export function workflowStageStateErrors(catalogValue: unknown, selectionValue: unknown, value: unknown, currentPrimaryStateValue?: unknown): readonly string[] {
  if (projectWorkflowSelectionErrors(catalogValue, selectionValue).length > 0) return ["project-workflow-selection-invalid"];
  try {
    const errors = validationErrors(value, definition("WorkflowStageState"), "$");
    if (errors.length > 0) return [...new Set(errors)];
    const catalog = record(catalogValue)!;
    const selection = record(selectionValue)!;
    const state = record(value)!;
    const expectedSelection = { selectionId: selection.selectionId, selectionRevisionId: selection.selectionRevisionId, revision: selection.revision, revisionContentHash: selection.revisionContentHash };
    const profile = exactProfile(catalog, state.profile);
    if (state.projectId !== selection.projectId || stableJson(state.selection) !== stableJson(expectedSelection) || stableJson(state.profile) !== stableJson(selection.profile) || profile === null) errors.push("stage-state-binds-selection-and-profile");
    const parent = record(state.parentState);
    if (state.stageStateId === state.stageStateRevisionId || (state.revision === 1 && parent !== null) || (state.revision > 1 && (parent === null || parent.revision !== state.revision - 1 || parent.stageStateId !== state.stageStateId || parent.stageStateRevisionId === state.stageStateRevisionId || parent.revisionContentHash === state.revisionContentHash))) errors.push("stage-state-binds-selection-and-profile");
    const completed = state.status === "completed";
    const attention = ["attention-required", "blocked"].includes(state.status);
    const stale = state.status === "stale";
    const skipped = state.status === "skipped-with-rationale";
    if (completed !== (state.completionEvidenceIds.length > 0) || attention !== (state.attention !== null) || stale !== (state.staleCauses.length > 0) || skipped !== (state.skipRationale !== null)) errors.push("stage-state-status-shape-is-consistent");
    const stages = new Map((profile?.stages ?? []).map((stage: Record<string, any>) => [stage.stageKey, stage]));
    if (state.passNumber > 1 && profile?.cyclePolicy !== "revisitable") errors.push("stage-state-pass-matches-cycle-policy");
    if (state.navigationRole === "primary") {
      const stage = stages.get(state.stageKey) as Record<string, any> | undefined;
      if (stage === undefined || stage.pageContractId !== state.pageContractId || state.supportReturn !== null) errors.push("stage-state-binds-selection-and-profile");
    } else {
      const support = record(state.supportReturn);
      const current = support === null ? null : record(support.currentPrimaryState);
      const primary = current === null ? undefined : stages.get(current.stageKey) as Record<string, any> | undefined;
      const providedCurrent = record(currentPrimaryStateValue);
      const expectedCurrent = providedCurrent === null ? null : {
        stageStateId: providedCurrent.stageStateId,
        stageStateRevisionId: providedCurrent.stageStateRevisionId,
        revision: providedCurrent.revision,
        revisionContentHash: providedCurrent.revisionContentHash,
        projectId: providedCurrent.projectId,
        selection: providedCurrent.selection,
        profile: providedCurrent.profile,
        stageKey: providedCurrent.stageKey,
        pageContractId: providedCurrent.pageContractId,
        passNumber: providedCurrent.passNumber,
        status: providedCurrent.status,
      };
      if (current === null || primary === undefined || primary.pageContractId !== current.pageContractId
        || providedCurrent === null
        || providedCurrent.navigationRole !== "primary"
        || providedCurrent.status !== "current"
        || workflowStageStateErrors(catalogValue, selectionValue, providedCurrent).length > 0
        || stableJson(current) !== stableJson(expectedCurrent)
        || current.stageStateId === current.stageStateRevisionId
        || current.stageStateId === state.stageStateId
        || current.stageStateRevisionId === state.stageStateRevisionId
        || current.projectId !== state.projectId
        || stableJson(current.selection) !== stableJson(expectedSelection)
        || stableJson(current.profile) !== stableJson(state.profile)
        || (current.passNumber > 1 && profile?.cyclePolicy !== "revisitable")) errors.push("supporting-tool-return-is-explicit");
      const registered = new Set(catalog.registeredToolPageContractIds as string[]);
      const primaryPages = new Set((profile?.stages ?? []).map((stage: Record<string, any>) => stage.pageContractId));
      if (!registered.has(state.pageContractId) || primaryPages.has(state.pageContractId)) errors.push("supporting-tool-is-governed-and-outside-primary-sequence");
      if (state.stageKey !== `${state.pageContractId.slice(0, -5)}-1`) errors.push("supporting-tool-identity-is-governed");
    }
    return [...new Set(errors)];
  } catch {
    return ["workflow-stage-state-structure-invalid"];
  }
}

export function workflowProfileMigrationErrors(catalogValue: unknown, value: unknown): readonly string[] {
  if (workflowProfileCatalogErrors(catalogValue).length > 0) return ["workflow-profile-catalog-invalid"];
  try {
    const errors = validationErrors(value, definition("WorkflowProfileMigration"), "$");
    if (errors.length > 0) return [...new Set(errors)];
    const catalog = record(catalogValue)!;
    const migration = record(value)!;
    const fromProfile = exactProfile(catalog, migration.fromProfile);
    const toProfile = exactProfile(catalog, migration.toProfile);
    if (fromProfile === null || toProfile === null || stableJson(migration.fromProfile) === stableJson(migration.toProfile)) errors.push("migration-binds-exact-profile-revisions");
    if (migration.historyPolicy !== "preserve" || migration.requiresHumanAcceptance !== true || !immediateIntentRevision(migration.priorResearchIntent, migration.targetResearchIntent)) errors.push("migration-binds-exact-profile-revisions");
    if (fromProfile !== null && toProfile !== null) {
      const mappings = migration.stageMappings as Record<string, any>[];
      const sourceKeys = (fromProfile.stages as Record<string, any>[]).map((stage) => stage.stageKey);
      const mappedKeys = mappings.map((item) => item.fromStageKey);
      const targetKeys = new Set((toProfile.stages as Record<string, any>[]).map((stage) => stage.stageKey));
      if (!unique(mappedKeys) || stableJson([...mappedKeys].sort()) !== stableJson([...sourceKeys].sort()) || mappings.some((item) => (["retain", "map"].includes(item.disposition) && (item.targetStageKey === null || !targetKeys.has(item.targetStageKey))) || (item.targetStageKey !== null && !targetKeys.has(item.targetStageKey)))) errors.push("migration-covers-prior-stages");
      if (mappings.some((item) => !semanticStageMapping(fromProfile, toProfile, item))) errors.push("migration-disposition-is-semantic");
    }
    return [...new Set(errors)];
  } catch {
    return ["workflow-profile-migration-structure-invalid"];
  }
}

  try { const owned = ownedFrozen(value); return workflowProfileCatalogErrors(owned).length === 0 ? owned : null; } catch { return null; }
}

export function decodeWorkflowStageState(catalog: unknown, selection: unknown, value: unknown, currentPrimaryState?: unknown): WorkflowStageStateSnapshot | null {
  try { const owned = ownedFrozen(value); return workflowStageStateErrors(catalog, selection, owned, currentPrimaryState).length === 0 ? owned : null; } catch { return null; }
}
export function decodeWorkflowProfileMigration(catalog: unknown, value: unknown): WorkflowProfileMigrationSnapshot | null {
  try { const owned = ownedFrozen(value); return workflowProfileMigrationErrors(catalog, owned).length === 0 ? owned : null; } catch { return null; }
}
export function canonicalWorkflowProfileJson(value: unknown): string {
  const candidate = record(value);
  if (candidate === null || !["research-observatory-workflow-profile-catalog", "research-observatory-project-workflow-selection", "research-observatory-workflow-stage-state", "research-observatory-workflow-profile-migration"].includes(candidate.documentType)) throw new Error("invalid workflow profile contract document");
  return stableJson(value);
}
export function workflowProfileRecordSha256(value: unknown): string {
  return `sha256:${createHash("sha256").update(canonicalWorkflowProfileJson(value)).digest("hex")}`;
}
